description: Artificial Agency builds an AI-powered behavior engine that brings dynamic, unscripted NPCs and real-time decision-making to video games. Founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, the platform lets developers embed agents with perception, personality, and goals directly into gameplay.

Aspect Biosystems combines 3D bioprinting, therapeutic cells, and computational design to create implantable tissue therapeutics. The platform aims to deliver a new class of regenerative medicine, beginning with metabolic and endocrine diseases such as diabetes.

Attuned Intelligence believes getting healthcare help should feel human, no matter how busy the phones get. That's why they built a Voice AI Agent that answers every call instantly, speaks the caller's language, and connects them to the right care safely — while giving frontline teams the support they deserve.
CentML optimizes AI model performance and reduces compute costs for machine learning workloads. The company was acquired by Nvidia in 2025.
Chemix uses AI to design and optimize next-generation battery chemistries, accelerating material discovery for electric vehicles and the energy transition.

Cinder is the industry-leading trust and safety operations platform, helping organizations combat AI-powered abuse, fraud, and harmful content at scale. Founded by former Meta employees, Cinder provides mission-critical infrastructure protecting platforms including OpenAI, Spotify, and Depop from digital threats and manipulation. Cinder's platform automates threat detection, investigation, and response workflows through AI-powered agentic safety capabilities. Radical Ventures led the company's $41M Series B in 2026, bringing total funding past $60M alongside Accel, M12, and Y Combinator.

Cohere ensures organizations own their intelligence layer instead of renting it. When only a few big companies control the technology, people have little ability to shape how their AI systems work or evolve. Founded in 2019, Cohere is a security-first enterprise AI leader that empowers organizations to transition from experimental AI to reliable, secure, and fully controlled production systems. By building powerful foundation models and end-to-end solutions, Cohere partners with enterprises and public-sector agencies worldwide to solve real-world business problems. Their approach prioritizes maximum privacy and deployment flexibility—whether across clouds, private environments, or on-premises—ensuring that organizations in highly regulated industries maintain absolute ownership over their data and infrastructure.
Covariant builds AI that gives robots the ability to see, reason, and act in the real world, bringing dexterous automation to warehouses and supply chains.

Crusoe Energy is a leading developer of AI-optimized data center infrastructure, building the physical foundation that powers today's AI revolution. The company specializes in constructing large-scale, purpose-built data centers designed specifically for AI workloads. Crusoe's competitive advantage lies in its unparalleled access to energy resources, deep vertical integration, and supply chain expertise — enabling the company to build gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and at larger scales than competitors. The company has partnered with several of the world's largest technology companies, including OpenAI, for whom Crusoe is developing the massive 'Stargate' data center in Abilene, Texas.

Cyera is an AI-native data security platform that helps enterprises discover, classify, and protect sensitive data across hybrid cloud environments. Its agentless deployment scales to petabytes of data with 95% classification accuracy, letting organizations embrace AI while keeping their data secure. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Israel's Unit 8200, Cyera has grown to a $9B+ valuation with over $460M raised, making it a leading innovator in the fastest-growing category of enterprise security.
DatologyAI automates the curation and selection of training data to improve AI model performance. They help companies train better models with less data and less compute.

Decart is an AI research lab building real-time world models and ultra-optimized infrastructure that lets AI systems run at the speed of reality. Its foundational models include Lucy, powering immersive experiences that respond in under 30 milliseconds, and Oasis, built for physical AI and robotics. Founded in 2023 by alumni of Israel's Unit 8200, Decart combines deep systems-optimization expertise with frontier generative AI research. Radical Ventures led the company's $300M Series B in 2026 at a $4B valuation.
Delphina is an LLM-powered copilot for data science that accelerates how teams build, deploy, and improve predictive AI models.

Discovery Loop is a public benefit company automating the scientific method, deploying AI systems that run thousands of experiments in parallel — proposing hypotheses, executing tests, analyzing results, and iterating without human intervention. The team is starting with the automation of machine learning research, then intends to take on challenges across engineering, medicine, materials science, and clean energy — bringing together deep expertise in silicon, foundation models, and large-scale distributed computing.
Emerald AI develops software that turns energy-intensive AI data centers into flexible grid assets, cutting power draw during peak demand without sacrificing compute performance.

Etched builds frontier inference clusters designed to make AI inference dramatically faster, cheaper, and more abundant. Through deep co-design across the entire stack, Etched's rack-scale systems deliver best-in-class throughput and latency, powered by two novel computing technologies: Low Voltage Inference (LVI) and Cluster Scale Memory (CSM).
Firsthand lets publishers and brands build and distribute their own AI agents to consumers while retaining full control over their data and content.

General Magic rebuilds the operating layer of insurance with AI agents that handle the full brokerage workflow — customer conversations, underwriting, and compliance. The platform integrates directly into existing broker management systems, cutting quote times from 30 minutes to under three.

Generalist is a frontier AI robotics company building general-purpose embodied AI models that let robots master complex physical tasks. Its GEN-1 model achieves 99% reliability on dexterous manipulation — versus 64% for prior approaches — with 3x faster execution and emergent improvisational capabilities. Founded in 2024 by Pete Florence (former DeepMind robotics lead), Andy Zeng (co-author of PaLM-E), and Andrew Barry (Boston Dynamics), Generalist raised a $400M Series A led by Radical Ventures in 2026 at a $2B valuation.

Genesis Molecular AI unifies AI and biotech, pairing proven drug developers with an advanced small-molecule discovery platform. By bringing together drug developers, AI researchers, and software engineers, Genesis uses machine learning across the discovery pipeline to design and advance transformative new therapies faster than traditional methods allow.

Hebbia's AI platform is capable of reading and comprehending the untouched universe of unstructured, private data. Its 'neural search' enables a user to ask questions using natural language, with Hebbia searching all available data to provide answers immediately and accurately. From broad market research to targeted information extraction, Hebbia automates diligence workflows, acting as an AI Analyst and instantly surfacing deal points even humans miss.

Inherent is a London-based AI research lab building general-purpose inventive AI to accelerate scientific discovery, applying recursive self-improvement to both its models and its research organization.

Intrepid Labs, a University of Toronto spinout, uses an AI-driven robotic platform to autonomously design and test drug formulations — optimizing delivery format and dosing for better patient outcomes.
Founded by a key architect of DeepMind's Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold2, Latent Labs builds AI foundation models that make biology programmable through de novo protein design.

Mantic is a world-class technical team on a mission to solve the next AI grand challenge: predicting global events with superhuman accuracy and deploying this capability to power radically improved decision-making in business and government.

Mosaic is an AI-driven deal-modeling platform that generates financial models and LBO analyses for investment professionals. By automating the infrastructure of deal modeling — linking, calculations, and formatting — Mosaic delivers near-instantaneous, rules-based deal math with transparent, downloadable Excel outputs, freeing investors to focus on judgment rather than mechanics.

Muon Space builds and operates full-stack satellite systems that deliver mission-grade Earth-observation data to organizations without space expertise. From wildfire detection to climate resilience, Muon designs, launches, and manages custom satellite constellations end-to-end, turning raw orbital sensing into actionable planetary intelligence.

Nabla Bio combines generative AI with large-scale, human-relevant testing to turn drug development from trial-and-error into an engineered, designable process. The company is beginning with antibodies against the hardest, most intractable targets in medicine — designing therapeutics from first principles rather than discovering them by chance.

OffDeal is an AI-native investment bank for small and medium-sized businesses, using proprietary data and AI agents to run the M&A process at scale. The platform matches sellers with the right buyers and automates the workflow that has historically made SMB dealmaking slow and expensive — bringing institutional-grade advisory to a long-underserved market.
Orbital Industries uses generative AI to discover and design new materials, replacing slow lab trial-and-error with its foundation model to develop technologies for the energy transition.

Outset is an AI-moderated research platform that runs hundreds of qualitative interviews simultaneously across languages and geographies. Combining conversational AI with behavioral and emotional intelligence, Outset lets researchers hear, see, and understand their customers at a scale and speed that traditional one-on-one studies can't match.

P-1 AI is building an AI engineer for the physical world named Archie, which automates design work for complex physical systems. Archie uses multi-physics reasoning across domains like data-center cooling, industrial systems, and aerospace.

Periodic Labs is building scientific superintelligence to accelerate discovery in the physical sciences. The company’s platform combines frontier AI models, physics-based simulations, and autonomous robotic laboratories to create a closed-loop system where AI scientists can generate hypotheses, design experiments, and learn from outcomes. Founded by Liam Fedus, who co-created ChatGPT at OpenAI, and Dogus Cubuk, who led materials AI at Google DeepMind, Periodic Labs’ mission is to build the technology infrastructure for scientific discovery driven by AI.
Pixxel operates a constellation of hyperspectral imaging satellites that monitor the health of the planet, delivering AI-powered geospatial analysis for agriculture, energy, and the environment.
PocketHealth gives patients ownership of and access to their medical imaging while providing hospitals with modern image-sharing and management tools.
Prepared builds an AI platform for 911 call centers, delivering real-time transcription, instant multilingual translation, and intelligent dispatch support to accelerate emergency response.

Prime Intellect builds decentralized infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying frontier AI models at scale. Its full-stack platform lets organizations train and continuously improve their own agentic AI systems — without relying on frontier labs — by aggregating globally distributed compute and providing tools for reinforcement learning, evaluation, and inference serving. The company's fault-tolerant architecture trains across unreliable nodes with low network bandwidth, achieving up to 96% compute utilization across networks spanning multiple continents. Customers including Ramp and Zapier use Prime Intellect to train models optimized for their specific workflows, achieving superior performance at lower cost than frontier models. Radical Ventures led the company's $130M Series A in 2026.
Promise Robotics combines AI and robotics to transform the construction industry through automated manufacturing, building an industrial production system for sustainable and affordable housing.
Reka develops multimodal AI models that understand text, images, video, and audio, delivering enterprise-grade models with privacy and security built in.

Ribbon is an AI recruiting platform that conducts two-way voice interviews around the clock, screens candidates against custom rubrics, and integrates with leading applicant tracking systems to speed up high-volume hiring.

Ricursive Intelligence automates semiconductor design with reinforcement learning, compressing chip development from years to weeks — where better-designed chips enable more powerful AI in a compounding loop.
Serval is an AI-powered platform for IT service management that automates routine help-desk and operational requests through natural-language interfaces.
Signal 1 embeds AI-driven insights into hospital workflows, helping health systems address surgical backlogs, staffing shortages, and clinician burden while improving patient outcomes.
Slingshot AI is building Ash, a foundation model trained specifically for psychological support, combining behavioral-health data with reinforcement learning to deliver specialized therapeutic care.

Powered by proprietary models and a brand-new out-of-the-editor UX, Solver is an agent that completes repository-level tasks directly from natural instructions — even text taken verbatim from an issue tracker. Solver is a “full-stack” ML company on a mission to radically improve developer productivity: they build their own datasets, models, platform, and user experience. The team has built a suite of novel foundation models over what we believe to be the most comprehensive software-engineering dataset in existence today.
Spara builds and deploys conversational AI agents across chat, email, and voice that qualify leads, engage prospects, and drive sales pipeline.
Synex Medical develops non-invasive monitoring that uses magnetic resonance to measure metabolites like glucose without needles, enabling real-time, preventive metabolic health tracking.
Twelve Labs builds multimodal AI that understands video with human-like comprehension, making massive video libraries as searchable and analyzable as text.
Unblocked helps engineering teams understand the “why” behind their code, connecting scattered information across development tools to surface context about intent, history, and decisions.
Unlearn creates AI-generated digital twins of patients to accelerate clinical trials and improve trial efficiency. Their technology allows for smaller, faster, and more successful clinical studies.
Untether AI designs energy-efficient semiconductor technology purpose-built for high-performance AI inference, from the data center to the edge.
V7 automates data labeling and training-data workflows with AI, helping machine-learning teams build models dramatically faster.
Vizcom is an AI design platform that turns hand-drawn sketches into photorealistic renderings and 3D models, built for professional industrial designers to iterate at speed.

Waabi, founded by AI pioneer Raquel Urtasun, is building the next generation of self-driving technology — unleashing the power of AI to drive safely in the real world. The company's breakthrough AI-first approach leverages deep learning, probabilistic inference and complex optimization to create software that is end-to-end trainable and capable of very complex reasoning. Together with a revolutionary closed-loop simulator, this enables testing at scale of both common driving scenarios and safety-critical edge cases.
Founded by Fei-Fei Li, World Labs builds large world models that give AI spatial intelligence — the ability to perceive, generate, and interact with the full 3D world, not just 2D images.

Writer is a full-stack generative AI platform for the enterprise, uniting IT and business teams to build and deploy secure AI applications and agents, powered by its Palmyra models and graph-based retrieval.
Xanadu is building practical, photonic quantum computers — using particles of light to perform computations at room temperature — with the goal of making quantum computing broadly accessible.
You.com delivers accurate answers to complex questions and automates workflows, orchestrating information across private data, live web search, and large language models.
Founded by AI researchers Devi Parikh, Dhruv Batra, and Abhishek Das, Yutori builds agent-first AI assistants that autonomously carry out everyday digital tasks — a “chief of staff for everyone.”
